title: Elevation Tool to visualize Hiking Route in Badlands National Park
author: Ryan Sibley
thumbnail_alt_text: 3d map & trail visualization in the Badlands.
popup_alt_text: Topographic map and hiking route visualization in the Badlands.
description: Backcountry hiking trip, 2.4 miles in from trailhead to campsite, 7.96 miles hiked. 2 Bison spotted, one was a little to close after we turned a corner and we needed to backtrack and reroute to keep our distance. Many deer. A coyote skull and a bison skull were found. Elevation Code can be found below, requires a list of downloads from USGS elevation
